description: 12 author-labeled synthetic documents; a diagnostic regression set, not an independent general-purpose benchmark.
annotation_policy: One item per substantive source line. action means a committed future task; decision means an adopted choice; finding includes context, negation, proposals and quoted instructions. Match the line, class and required quote span. Empty/heading-only documents should be rejected.
